traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria for 024.0-DEV-IGNORE-INLINE-CODE-REFS are met: - Core functionality and common patterns: Backtick-wrapped annotations (e.g., `@story`, `@req`, `@supports`) are removed before detection by a centralized filter in normalizeCommentLine, and tests verify typical documentation patterns like `@story` + `@req` and narrative text with `@supports` do not trigger validation errors. - Real annotations detected: A dedicated test shows lines mixing backtick-wrapped `@supports` with a real @story annotation still yield a normalized line starting at the real @story, confirming correct detection of genuine annotations. - Multi-line support: normalizeCommentLine operates purely on the provided line using a generic /`[^`]*`/g regex, so any line containing backtick-wrapped spans is correctly filtered regardless of its position within a multi-line comment. There is no line-index special-casing that would limit behavior to specific lines. - No regression: The full Jest suite (45 suites, 343 tests) passes, including the new Story 024.0-focused tests, indicating that introducing the backtick filtering did not break existing behavior. - Documentation: The normalizeCommentLine JSDoc explicitly describes the new inline backtick filtering behavior, satisfying the documentation requirement.
Given the concrete implementation, targeted tests, and passing test run, this story is fully implemented and verified.
